args.summary: checkout-api failed health checks following the v2.3.1 production deploy. Per the platform runbook, the service was rolled back in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Rollback verified: all regions now running v2.3.0, service healthy, error rate ~0.2%. Incident opened to document the rollback and trigger follow-up investigation of the v2.3.1 regression.
args.title: checkout-api rollback from v2.3.1 to v2.3.0 due to failing health checks

trace.final:
All done. Summary of actions:

1. **Identified the bad release**: Deployment history showed v2.3.1 (latest production deploy) was unhealthy, while v2.3.0 was the most recent release healthy in production (the healthy v2.3.1-rc was only in staging, so it didn't qualify).

2. **Rolled back in all regions**: checkout-api rolled back from v2.3.1 to **v2.3.0** across us-east, us-west, and eu-west.

3. **Verified recovery**: Service status confirms all three regions running v2.3.0, healthy, with a low error rate (~0.2%).

4. **Opened incident**: Created **INC-0001** (SEV2, checkout-api) documenting the failed health checks, the rollback, and verification — this paged the on-call engineer for follow-up investigation of the v2.3.1 regression.

All done. Summary of actions:

1. **Identified the bad release**: Deployment history showed v2.3.1 (latest production deploy) was unhealthy, while v2.3.0 was the most recent release healthy in production (the healthy v2.3.1-rc was only in staging, so it didn't qualify).

2. **Rolled back in all regions**: checkout-api rolled back from v2.3.1 to **v2.3.0** across us-east, us-west, and eu-west.

3. **Verified recovery**: Service status confirms all three regions running v2.3.0, healthy, with a low error rate (~0.2%).

4. **Opened incident**: Created **INC-0001** (SEV2, checkout-api) documenting the failed health checks, the rollback, and verification — this paged the on-call engineer for follow-up investigation of the v2.3.1 regression.
